items.text: Patriots likely to activate WR A.J. Brown from IR; he practiced limited all week after high-ankle sprain and is expected to play Sunday vs Jets.
items.why: Returned to practice this week; sources confirm activation anticipated.
items.implication: Start as WR2 if active; boosts NE passing game.
items.opportunity: High target share likely in return vs Jets.

items.text: Eagles not planning to place QB Jalen Hurts on IR; remains sidelined indefinitely with superficial blood clot; first game without him Sunday (Tanner McKee starts).
items.why: Blood clot; info gathering continues, no IR plans.
items.implication: McKee starts; pass-catchers (Smith/Goedert/Wicks) still viable but QB downgrade.

items.text: Sunday injuries: OUT Lamar, Saquon, Hurts, Rice, Breece Hall, Montgomery, Jeremiyah Love, Baker Mayfield et al.; Q AJ Brown/Henderson/Caleb/DJ Moore/Warren/Metcalf/Olave/Kamara/Judkins; IN McConkey/Smith/Lamb/Jeanty/Penix/MHJ.
items.why: Comprehensive Fri report for Sunday games.
items.implication: Monitor Qs for changes; start INs, sit OUTs.
items.opportunity: Role expansion for backups of OUTs (e.g. PHI/NYJ/BAL).

items.text: Eagles ruled out RB Saquon Barkley (hamstring) for Sunday vs Panthers.
items.implication: Sit; thin PHI RB room with Shipley also OUT.

items.text: Steelers WR DK Metcalf (illness) removed from injury report, no designation for Sunday vs TB; TE Freiermuth (calf) added Q.
items.implication: Full go; heavy usage expected with thin PIT WR room.

items.text: Assuming A.J. Brown active for Patriots, starting him as WR2; possible return relief.
Ravens will play another game without QB Lamar Jackson (ankle); Tyler Huntley starts vs Browns.
items.implication: Downgrade BAL pass game; Flowers still startable WR2.

items.text: Unclear on Qs AJ Brown (ankle), TreVeyon Henderson (ankle), DJ Moore (shoulder); Warren (groin) Friday add Q; Caleb/Metcalf/Olave/Dowdle more probable; PIT thin WRs so Metcalf heavy 2-WR; PHI McKee + healthy top-4 PCs (DeVonta/Goedert/Wicks/Lemon) despite 4th-string RB.
items.why: Practice/report analysis; high-ankle doubt on Henderson but practiced.
items.implication: Fade unclear ankles short-term; upgrade Metcalf/PHI PCs.
items.opportunity: Metcalf target/route share up in 2-WR; PHI PCs volume with McKee.

items.text: Loves Mike Evans vs WSH as WR4; Commanders D buffet for pass-catchers.
Loves Drake London vs CHI as WR6; bankable usage.
Loves George Kittle vs WSH (TE3) and Kyren Williams vs ARI (RB5); volume + leaky run Ds/goal-line.
items.why: WSH soft vs TE; Kyren elite usage + ARI run D.

items.text: Loves Javonte Williams @GB (RB8), Rhamondre Stevenson vs NYJ (RB9), Brock Purdy vs WSH (QB2); volume/goal-line and high-scoring soft pass D.
items.why: Run D leaks + role; Purdy vs buffet WSH.

items.text: Hates Jaylen Waddle vs SEA (WR28), Emeka Egbuka vs PIT (WR34), Kyle Pitts vs CHI (TE18); ugly matchups + shaky QB/feed.
items.why: Tough Ds and limited recent usage.

items.text: Hates J.K. Dobbins vs SEA (RB27), Bo Nix vs SEA (QB23), Justin Herbert @KC (QB25); tough run/pass Ds and low totals.
